# Zeus UI

Pick every element. See it live. Your agent builds exactly that. Free, live UI components and a Studio for people who build with coding agents.

- [Agent manifest](https://myzeusui.com/agents.json): 312 components and templates with examples and install commands.
- [Registry](https://myzeusui.com/r/registry.json)
- [Styles](https://myzeusui.com/styles/)
- [Setup for agents](https://myzeusui.com/agents/)

## Install

- Source: `npx --yes --allow-remote=all --package=https://myzeusui.com/install/zeus-ui-0.4.0.tgz zeus-ui add <name>` copies the source, its dependencies and styles into your React project.
- shadcn: `npx shadcn@latest add https://myzeusui.com/r/<name>.json`
- MCP: `claude mcp add zeus -- npx --yes --allow-remote=all --package=https://myzeusui.com/install/zeus-mcp-0.4.0.tgz zeus-mcp`

## Components

- [Controls](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-controls/): Shared controls, scoped overlays and motion primitives
- [Balance card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-balance-card/): A compact balance card with a framed account panel, overlapping account marks, large numeric hierarchy, and a shared two-action footer
- [Compact card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-compact-card/): A compact generic card with a layered textured backdrop, status, overlapping people, flexible details, supporting context, and a focused action
- [Invite card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-invite-card/): A referral invite card with reward artwork, a concise three-step explainer, dismiss behavior, and a copyable personal link
- [Folder card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-folder-card/): A near-square collection card with a full-bleed media layer, a continuous folder-shaped content surface, and anchored metadata
- [Story card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-story-card/): A tall editorial story card with category and date markers, concise narrative copy, and a location-aware image treatment
- [Profile card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-profile-card/): A compact professional profile card with live availability, avatar-led identity, focused contact actions, and a layered status tray
- [Text swap](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-text-swap/): A fixed-footprint hover label where alternating letters roll in opposite directions through a short motion blur
- [Text highlight](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-text-highlight/): Animated text highlights in looping and progressive layouts, with coordinated colour, blur and position transitions
- [Morphic tooltip](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-morphic-tooltip/): A shared-layout tooltip primitive with one animated surface that morphs between triggers for polished hover and focus hints
- [Morphic command palette](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-morphic-command-palette/): A simple search field and grouped command list, with smooth resizing as results change and one animated selection highlight
- [Agent chat input](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-agent-chat-input/): A prompt box for agents in four layouts, from a spacious creative composer to a compact pill, with attachments, model selection and submit states
- [Voice agent](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-voice-agent/): A voice assistant in session and dock layouts, with an animated orb, connection states and microphone controls
- [Data table](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-data-table/): A searchable data table in responsive, compact and paginated layouts, with sorting, filters and row actions
- [Stacked bar chart](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-stacked-bar-chart/): Stacked bars over time that grow from the baseline, with a tooltip that glides beside the active bar, reference lines, projected bars, series toggles, and arrow-key navigation
- [Segmented meter](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-segmented-meter/): A capacity meter split into colored segments, with a gliding tooltip, a linked legend, selection, and hover state you can share with tables or lists
- [Sparkline](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-sparkline/): A compact trend line that draws in from the left and renders correctly before hydration
- [Flip card](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-flip-card/): An image card that flips inline or opens a detail dialog, with keyboard focus and motion states
- [Animated dropdown](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-animated-dropdown/): Four dropdown compositions demonstrating the shared animated focus surface across pointer and keyboard navigation, controlled selection, text triggers, and nested states
- [Animated modal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-animated-modal/): Compose a focused dialog with the shared inputs and buttons, keyboard dismissal, and automatic focus restoration
- [Audit trail](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-audit-trail/): See who changed what, narrow the history by category or actor, and inspect recorded values in an animated modal
- [Approval queue](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-approval-queue/): Review pending requests, approve or decline with a note, request changes, and keep completed reviews available for reference
- [Log explorer](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-log-explorer/): Inspect a live log stream with counted severity tabs, searchable entries, frozen pause snapshots, and copyable inline payloads
- [Notification center](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-notification-center/): Notifications in dropdown and panel layouts, with filtering, read status, item actions and detail views
- [Voice conversation](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-voice-conversation/): Controlled listening, thinking, speaking, and connection states. Connect the audio level, transcript, and callbacks to your voice service
- [File upload](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-file-upload/): A dropzone that reacts to dragged files, accepts paste and browsing, validates type and size, and tracks each upload with progress, speed, pause, retry, image previews, and a rolling summary
- [What's new](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-whats-new/): A corner teaser with stacked thumbnails opens a release dialog with one feature per slide: drifting media or custom animated media, highlights, a try-it action, step dots, swipe and arrow-key navigation, and a finish step that links to the full changelog
- [Usage budget](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-usage-budget/): A segmented usage meter with resource costs, animated totals, and an adjustable monthly budget
- [Research sources](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-research-sources/): A searchable reference library with source filters, readable excerpts, and context selection
- [Conversion funnel](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-conversion-funnel/): Explore conversion stages with an interactive Recharts chart, period controls, and drop-off details
- [Model picker](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-model-picker/): A searchable model selector in grouped and provider-rail layouts, with keyboard navigation and animated selection
- [Code artifact](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-code-artifact/): A compact code artifact using the public Artemis agent code renderer, with syntax highlighting, line numbers, copy, and download
- [Document artifact](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-document-artifact/): Preview and edit a document, revisit saved versions, copy content, and download Markdown
- [AI thinking loader](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-ai-thinking-loader/): Six animated status indicators for an assistant that is processing a request, with reduced-motion support
- [What we offer](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-what-we-offer/): Three feature sections combining service descriptions, illustrated panels and calls to action in different layouts
- [Empty states](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-empty-states/): Four illustrated empty states for archives, search, inboxes and project boards, with contextual actions
- [Morphic card modal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-morphic-card-modal/): Apple-style card expansion modal. A card morphs into a full overlay using shared layout animation — no position hacks, just framer layoutId
- [Blog sections](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-blog-sections/): Article collections in image-card, featured-story, list and compact-card layouts, with category filters where applicable
- [Announcement banners](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-announcement-banners/): Announcements in gradient, shader, rotating-ribbon and stacked-card layouts, with dismissal and navigation controls
- [App showcase](https://myzeusui.com/elements/artemis-app-showcase/): A phone floating on a mesh-gradient shader stage, flanked by four features. Photo-rich screens slide in from the direction of travel and play their own detail motion, teammate activity pops beside the device, and the phone tilts toward the pointer. Auto-advance pauses on hover, focus, and when off screen

- [Background Fill Button](https://myzeusui.com/elements/background-fill-button/): A rounded background rises from below as the button gently compresses
- [Circle Fill Button](https://myzeusui.com/elements/circle-fill-button/): A circle grows from the cursor entry point to fill every corner in the same duration
- [Curve Fill Button](https://myzeusui.com/elements/curve-fill-button/): A curved wave enters from the nearest pointer edge and rolls back out
- [Animated Icon Button](https://myzeusui.com/elements/animated-icon-button/): A circular icon background fills the button while icons cycle diagonally
- [Magnetic Button](https://myzeusui.com/elements/magnetic-button/): The button and its label follow the pointer independently before springing home
- [Rainbow Button](https://myzeusui.com/elements/rainbow-button/): A dark button with a flowing rainbow border and a glow that expands on hover
- [Text Underline](https://myzeusui.com/elements/text-underline/): An underline draws from the left and erases toward the right on hover or focus
- [Mesh Gradient](https://myzeusui.com/elements/mesh-gradient/): Moving blended color fields with pointer displacement and a static fallback
- [Dithering](https://myzeusui.com/elements/dithering/): Ordered dot rendering with a smooth lens that restores original image colors
- [Image Glitch](https://myzeusui.com/elements/image-glitch/): Analog scan lines, separated color channels and digital block tearing on hover
- [Gooey Hover Reveal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/gooey-hover-reveal/): A decaying liquid mask reveals content under the moving pointer
- [Dither Cursor Trail](https://myzeusui.com/elements/dither-cursor-trail/): Pointer marks break into ordered dots as their trail fades away
- [Image Dissolve Scroll](https://myzeusui.com/elements/image-dissolve-scroll/): Scroll dissolves an image through irregular noise boundaries and a glowing edge
- [Grid Chapters](https://myzeusui.com/elements/grid-chapters/): Pinned chapter headings exchange masked lines while image columns pass independently through a visible grid
- [Network Globe](https://myzeusui.com/elements/network-globe/): A draggable dotted sphere rotates toward selected locations and draws raised routes between them
- [Dock Footer](https://myzeusui.com/elements/dock-footer/): Scroll uncovers a staggered footer and a translucent navigation dock that expands at the page bottom
- [Flip Filter](https://myzeusui.com/elements/flip-filter/): Category and grid/list changes preserve product cards through measured, interruptible FLIP layout transitions
- [Capsule Hero](https://myzeusui.com/elements/capsule-hero/): Large letterforms part around a rounded media aperture that expands on activation and reverses on close
- [Wipe Slider](https://myzeusui.com/elements/wipe-slider/): Directional background wipes coordinate masked slide text and a rolling percentage index
- [Step Wipe](https://myzeusui.com/elements/step-wipe/): A pinned product sequence synchronizes separate background, foreground, caption and numbering wipes with scroll
- [Gradient Footer](https://myzeusui.com/elements/gradient-footer/): A scroll-revealed footer combines a bottom glow, width-filling brand typography and animated link underlines
- [Testimonial Globe](https://myzeusui.com/elements/testimonial-globe/): Portraits rotate on a draggable sphere beneath translucent quotation cards with a lighter mobile presentation
- [Drift Gallery](https://myzeusui.com/elements/drift-gallery/): Product cards separate on grab and travel with release inertia that controls grain and color intensity
- [Morphing Pill Menu](https://myzeusui.com/elements/morphing-pill-menu/): A compact pill expands into navigation with staggered and rolling links
- [Gooey Menu](https://myzeusui.com/elements/gooey-menu/): Floating actions separate through liquid connections in arc, radial, row or grid arrangements
- [Mega Menu](https://myzeusui.com/elements/mega-menu/): A shared dropdown resizes between navigation groups with mobile accordion navigation
- [Fullscreen Slide Menu](https://myzeusui.com/elements/fullscreen-slide-menu/): Navigation turns the page away and reveals a full-screen menu with changing imagery
- [Scatter Cluster](https://myzeusui.com/elements/scatter-cluster/): A central overlapping pile of image and statistic cards separates into a surrounding arrangement with scroll progress, revealing the headline beneath
- [Multi Flip](https://myzeusui.com/elements/multi-flip/): An overlapping irregular card pile transitions into an ordered grid with scroll, preserving each card while changing its position and rotation
- [Velocity Clip](https://myzeusui.com/elements/velocity-clip/): The visible media region contracts and releases according to scrolling speed, with stronger clipping during faster movement
- [SVG Draw Path](https://myzeusui.com/elements/svg-draw-path/): Scroll progress reveals an SVG stroke from its beginning to its end, following the supplied path geometry
- [Progress](https://myzeusui.com/elements/progress/): Page progress is represented by a ring, linear fill, or numeric percentage that follows the document's scroll position
- [Parallax](https://myzeusui.com/elements/parallax/): Multiple elements respond to scroll with different displacement rates, creating relative depth between foreground and background layers
- [Mask Reveal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/mask-reveal/): Scroll opens or closes a configurable shape mask over content, including circular, rectangular, organic, or supplied outlines
- [Hide Header](https://myzeusui.com/elements/hide-header/): The navigation hides during downward movement and returns when direction reverses, with thresholds and zones that keep it visible
- [Flip Zone](https://myzeusui.com/elements/flip-zone/): One media element moves and resizes between successive layout frames as scroll advances, maintaining a continuous visual identity
- [Element Reveal](https://myzeusui.com/elements/element-reveal/): Elements enter using selectable fade, translation, scale, clipping, blur, or rotation treatments, with optional group staggering
- [Counter](https://myzeusui.com/elements/counter/): Numbers animate to target values on entry, using either smooth counting or independently rolling digit columns with optional units
- [Background Color](https://myzeusui.com/elements/background-color/): Foreground and background colors interpolate between authored scroll zones instead of switching abruptly at section boundaries
- [Animated Grid](https://myzeusui.com/elements/animated-grid/): Image columns advance at different rates during scrolling, producing a multi-column parallax composition with selectable motion variations
- [Random Rotate](https://myzeusui.com/elements/random-rotate/): Items appear with independently varied rotational offsets, giving their final arrangement an irregular placed-by-hand character
- [Photo Stack Gallery](https://myzeusui.com/elements/photo-stack-gallery/): Clicking a compact image stack opens a thumbnail strip and large feature image; choosing another thumbnail exchanges their positions.
- [Spiral Gallery](https://myzeusui.com/elements/spiral-gallery/): Image planes orbit through a vertical helix; dragging changes rotation velocity, release preserves momentum, and the composition continues drifting.
- [Lens Rail](https://myzeusui.com/elements/lens-rail/): A draggable horizontal image rail enlarges cards near its center and compresses distant cards; arrow controls move the focal position.
- [Expanding Strip](https://myzeusui.com/elements/expanding-strip/): Hovering a narrow image column widens that column, compresses its siblings, and reveals its caption inside the expanded area.
- [Index Wipe](https://myzeusui.com/elements/index-wipe/): Hovering indexed chapter names changes the full background through a directional wipe and rolls the numeric index to the active item.
- [Card Fan](https://myzeusui.com/elements/card-fan/): Hovering a stacked group spreads images into an arc; targeting one card raises it and widens neighboring spacing before the stack closes again.
- [Radial Gallery](https://myzeusui.com/elements/radial-gallery/): Image cards occupy a slowly rotating circular arrangement sized to the viewport; the ring can appear whole or partially outside the frame.
- [Circular Slider](https://myzeusui.com/elements/circular-slider/): Cards travel along the visible upper arc of a large circle; dragging or arrows advances the sequence and the nearest card snaps into position.
- [Infinite Parallax Slider](https://myzeusui.com/elements/infinite-parallax-slider/): A looping horizontal carousel offsets internal layers at different rates, supports autonomous playback, and pauses when hovered.
- [Image Follow List](https://myzeusui.com/elements/image-follow-list/): Hovering a project row displays its image near the pointer; the preview tracks movement and switches content across rows.
